```python
def shrink_typed_dict_types(typed_dicts: List[type], max_typed_dict_size: int
    ) ->type:
    if not typed_dicts:
        return Dict[Any, Any]
    
    if len(typed_dicts) == 1:
        return typed_dicts[0]
    
    first_dict = typed_dicts[0]
    if all(types_equal(td, first_dict) for td in typed_dicts):
        return first_dict
    
    all_value_types = []
    for td in typed_dicts:
        required_fields, optional_fields = field_annotations(td)
        all_value_types.extend(required_fields.values())
        all_value_types.extend(optional_fields.values())
    
    if not all_value_types:
        return Dict[Any, Any]
    
    value_type = shrink_types(all_value_types, max_typed_dict_size)
    return Dict[str, value_type]


def shrink_types(types, max_typed_dict_size):
    types_list = list(types)
    
    if not types_list:
        return Any
    
    unique_types = []
    for t in types_list:
        if not any(types_equal(t, ut) for ut in unique_types):
            unique_types.append(t)
    
    if len(unique_types) == 1:
        return unique_types[0]
    
    typed_dicts = [t for t in unique_types if is_anonymous_typed_dict(t)]
    non_typed_dicts = [t for t in unique_types if not is_anonymous_typed_dict(t)]
    
    if typed_dicts:
        if non_typed_dicts:
            typed_dict_type = shrink_typed_dict_types(typed_dicts, max_typed_dict_size)
            return Union[tuple([typed_dict_type] + non_typed_dicts)]
        else:
            return shrink_typed_dict_types(typed_dicts, max_typed_dict_size)
    
    return Union[tuple(unique_types)]
```
